posts.title: Why I Am Retiring from Debian
posts.description: Today I asked to retire as an official Debian Developer. Here is the message I sent to the project, lightly edited for this blog. I joined Debian in the early 2000s for technical reasons. I believed that free and open source software was the best way to solve hard engineering problems and to advance technology for the benefit of human civilization.
